kind: agentic microbench (12 task families) — N=10, two reasoning arms, + cross-model comparison + GPU power
claim_scope: Quality/behavior of Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (UD-Q3_K_XL GGUF) on llama.cpp through the MMBT 12-family agentic microbench, no-think vs think, on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell; compared against Step-3.7-Flash-NVFP4 (same rig) and Qwen3.6-27B / Qwen3-Coder-Next at Q4/AWQ (microbench-2026-04-28). Single rig, ten replicates per cell (N=10) for 397B. Phase-1 cells graded with the fixed phase1_grade.py. Includes dual-GPU power telemetry.

hardware.host: Tower2 (ASUS Pro WS WRX90E-SAGE SE, Threadripper PRO 7965WX)
hardware.gpus: 2x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 96 GB each
hardware.interconnect: PCIe host bridge (nvidia-smi topo -m = NODE); NO NVLink

engine.note: GGUF via llama.cpp server. Tool-calling enabled with --jinja (default-on in b9014). --reasoning-format none is REQUIRED for the think arm: the default extracts chain-of-thought into reasoning_content, leaving content empty, which the agentic harness reads as an early stop (dies ~iter 3). A thinking-off smoke cannot catch this.

model.per_file_hashes: See the HuggingFace repo for canonical per-file hashes; not recomputed locally (167 GB).

serving_config.split_mode: layer (pipeline parallel; -sm row tensor-parallel is ~45% slower on decode on this PCIe topology)
serving_config.single_stream_decode_tok_s: ~71-74 (Q3_K_XL, pipeline; matches the prior 397B reference run)

harness.max_model_len_flag: --max-model-len 131072 (matches served -c so request max_tokens math doesn't exceed ctx and 400)
harness.smoke_gate: PASS (extraction, thinking off): tool-calling proven in harness, all fields correct, done_signal

results.think_vs_nothink: net -10 at N=10 (82->72), decisively negative via concentrated redistribution: thinking helps p3_market (8/10->10/10) but craters p3_doc (9/10->2/10, verbosity vs 700-word limit) and p3_pm (5/10->0/10, over-deliberation). All other tasks identical.
results.n_variance: N=10 overturns small-N luck: p3_market no-think is a majority-verdict FLIP 1/3 (N=3) -> 8/10 (N=10) (auto-flagged in findings-n10.md). p3_pm no-think coin-flip 5/10; p3_doc 9/10. Zero-variance (10/10 or 0/10): p1_bugfix, p2_extract/ci/hallucination/triage, p3_business; testwrite/refactor/writing.
results.power: 3868+ paired samples: GPU0 mean ~300W/max 539W (90% of 600 cap), GPU1 ~275W/max 475W; combined median 670W (56% of 1200 cap), max 985W (82%), 0 samples within 5% of full; GPU0 leads GPU1 (+27W) = pipeline -sm layer alternation; decode 339W vs CPU-tool 125W/GPU. Never full on both.
results.cross_model: Aggregate ties 7-8/12 across 397B / Step-3.7-Flash / Qwen3.6-27B-Q4 / Coder-Next-Q4 (~15x param range). 27B/Coder use Q4/AWQ refs (microbench-2026-04-28, N=1, clean); fresh Q8/FP8 EXCLUDED as serving failures (35B 36/36 HTTP-400, 27B-Q8 23/36 runaway). Failure temperament tracks lineage not size: 397B+27B stall, Coder+Flash run away.
results.runaways: zero max_tokens/length runaways across all 240 N=10 cells (Step-3.7-Flash ran away on p3_market at low effort; 27B-Q8 ran away 23/36). 397B pathology is stalling (stuck-loop / model_stopped), not runaway; thinking clears the no-think market stall. Failure temperament tracks training lineage not size.
